Financial services virtual assistant for invoices and reporting

A finance virtual assistant helps your team organise invoice intake, client records, reporting and approval queues.

An accounts payable virtual assistant can check incoming bills against source documents, flag duplicate invoices and track missing references. Your finance team gets an approval queue showing what’s ready, when it’s due and what still needs a decision.

Accounting, mortgage and insurance operations

A financial services virtual assistant can coordinate routine records and follow-ups. Agree who owns advice, underwriting, claims decisions and the release of funds.

Accounting teams

A finance virtual assistant can organise receipts, aging and reconciliations, prepare draft reporting and close packs, gather client documents and track accountant review. Link payout and fee records for store accounting.

Mortgage and lending

Track application intake, appointment confirmations, document requests, milestones and borrower follow-ups in the approved CRM. Escalate missing documents and approval questions to the loan owner.

Insurance and advisory firms

A financial services virtual assistant can log renewals, gather policy or claim documents and prepare client updates. Compile approved portfolio, review and onboarding records for the responsible adviser.

Venture capital and investment teams

Research public deal information, update investor contacts, prepare board or meeting packs and track diligence requests and reporting deadlines. Investment decisions stay with the team.

An invoice arrives with incomplete details

A finance virtual assistant can trace an invoice back to the requester. An accounts payable virtual assistant should preserve the original document and approval status.

In this example, a vendor sends an invoice without the purchase reference the finance team expects. The finance virtual assistant prepares an exception for review. The purpose is to save the approver from reconstructing the history while keeping payment authority with the finance team.

  1. 01

    Log the original invoice

    Record when it arrived, the vendor reference and where the supporting document is stored. Check whether the invoice already exists in the intake queue. If there is a possible match, attach the reference and flag it for review rather than creating a second payable item.

  2. 02

    Show the information gap

    Compare the invoice with the purchase record your team identifies as authoritative. Record the missing reference and any other mismatch without changing either source. If a routine clarification is allowed, note who was contacted and when a response is due.

  3. 03

    Route the decision

    Give the reviewer the invoice, the expected reference and a short description of the gap. Mark who owns the next action and what should happen if the answer arrives after the period-end review. Record the reviewer’s decision in the approved system.

Prepare the inputs and rules.

Give your accounts payable virtual assistant a reviewed invoice example. Your financial services virtual assistant should know which required fields prevent a record moving forward.

Intake fields

Confirm which fields are safe to record in the queue and which must stay in the source system. Provide an example with a missing purchase reference and an example of a suspected duplicate.

Authority map

Write down who can clarify, approve, post, adjust or pay an invoice. Assign an alternate reviewer for urgent exceptions, and record which tasks are administrative only.

Period deadlines

Share the review cadence and reporting dates. Agree whether late items enter the current review or the next one and who decides when a cut-off exception is needed.

Decide what happens when the normal rule fails.

Your finance virtual assistant should flag a changed payment instruction. Your accounts payable virtual assistant can collect the details for the finance owner to verify.

Vendor details have changed

Keep the original message and alert the authorised owner through the established channel. The finance virtual assistant can document the request but should not update payment details or verify them on behalf of the approver.

A potential duplicate is already in review

Link the two references and show how they differ. Ask the reviewer to decide which record is authoritative before the queue is closed.

The owner is absent at cut-off

Use the agreed backup or flag the item for the next review. Include the deadline and why it cannot proceed so the substitute can make an informed decision.

Check the work against the original brief.

Review the outstanding log with your financial services virtual assistant. Your finance virtual assistant should distinguish resolved records from items waiting on a decision.

Approver readiness

Sample a few exceptions. Check whether each identifies the source, the discrepancy and the decision requested without requiring a second round of information gathering.

Queue ownership

Separate items awaiting a vendor from items awaiting finance review. Confirm that every item has a next owner and a review date.

Source integrity

Check the intake record against the original invoice. Review whether copying or reformatting introduced omissions, and update the intake fields if needed.

Leave a record the next person can use.

Your accounts payable virtual assistant should record the cutoff and next reviewer. Your financial services virtual assistant can use that record during a change of coverage.

Part of the handoverWhat to recordWhat the next owner can do

Open decisionsWhat to recordList each outstanding decision, the person who can make it and the point at which the next owner should follow up.What the next owner can doPrioritise the blocked items and ask a specific question when the next approval is due.
Time-sensitive commitmentsWhat to recordState the time zone, the next update due and any commitments that someone has already shared. Include the agreed backup contact.What the next owner can doKeep the next promise visible and make sure requests that cannot wait reach the correct person.
Changes to the instructionsWhat to recordRecord which rule changed, who approved it and when it starts. Keep an example that shows the difference in practice.What the next owner can doUse the current rule and compare new work with the agreed example during the next review.

Accounts payable virtual assistant coverage at close

Prepare your finance virtual assistant for close dates. Your accounts payable virtual assistant needs a clear order for missing references, approaching deadlines and reviewer follow-up.

Before the cutoff

Put recurring dates and named reviewers in the checklist. Record which invoices need a missing purchase reference, who can supply it and when to flag the item so it stays visible in the close review.

During the close

Keep open record checks in a queue with a status, a due date and a link to the source. Route bank detail changes and payment requests through the finance team’s own approval process before any action is taken.

After the cutoff

Summarise what was resolved, what moved to the next period and which items still need a decision. Keep the source documents in the agreed system so a reviewer can retrace the status without another export.

Frequently Asked Questions

Ask what your financial services virtual assistant can access. Agree which decisions remain with your team before an accounts payable virtual assistant starts.

Can a finance virtual assistant help with invoice processing?

A finance virtual assistant can organise documents, flag missing details and track reviews within the agreed scope. Your authorised staff approve, post and pay invoices.

Can the team help prepare a monthly reporting pack?

Agree the source files, reporting calendar and reviewers. A finance virtual assistant can collect inputs and flag exceptions for the person who owns the report.

What should we share before finance support starts?

Provide an intake checklist, sample documents, review deadlines and a named approver. Identify the system that holds the source record and which fields the finance virtual assistant is allowed to update.

Can a finance virtual assistant approve payments or change bank details?

Administrative support can include preparing documents, checking missing details and tracking reviews. Authorised finance staff own approval, payment execution and the verification of any requested change to banking or vendor details.

How are invoice exceptions reported?

Your financial services virtual assistant can maintain a log linking the invoice, the issue found, the reviewer and the next follow-up time. Agree the format so the finance owner can find the evidence needed for a decision.

Can coverage change around month-end?

Share close dates, expected peaks and reviewer availability before the period begins. Agree which records take priority and how extra work or a changed review window will be approved before adding it to the queue.
